name: National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cagayan de Oro Leg
short_description: A Cagayan de Oro half-marathon leg of the National MILO Marathon 2026, held August 23, 2026 at Centrio Mall.
ai_summary: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cagayan de Oro Leg is scheduled for August 23, 2026, starting and finishing near Centrio Mall on Corrales Avenue in Cagayan de Oro City, Philippines. Organized by RUNRIO Inc., the event offers five distance options: 1km, 3km, 5km, 10km, and a 21.1km half marathon as the primary distance. Registration for this leg is currently open to interested runners.
